program.name: Doctor of Medicine (MD, six-year undergraduate entry)

requirement.applicantContext: School-leaving IB qualification for Doctor of Medicine (MD, six-year undergraduate entry) at the Nicosia campus in Cyprus.
requirement.subjectNotes: Earn a combined 16 points at Higher Level. Include biology and at least one of chemistry, physics or mathematics. The university states the combined score without prescribing separate HL grades.
requirement.conditions: The school also reviews science preparation, English proficiency and suitability at interview.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Doctor of Medicine (MD, six-year undergraduate entry) · International Baccalaureate
source.evidence: 32 overall and a combined score of 16 at Higher Level
